WHY THE STAGE WILL NOT CATCH IT. `heavy` is not a stage phase (decision 0148 removed it; 0426 restored it to MERGE only), and heavy is exactly the tier that compares a live probe against the committed census fixtures. Do not read it as clearing them.

There is a chance the `gate` phase reddens anyway, if one of your 7 census pins is an ordinary (non-heavy) test asserting a census value. If that happens it is a true finding, not a flaky pin: treat a red there as the stage telling you the goldens moved, and do not re-pin it by hand to green.
